about: The engine's sentence for every answer to a flag run, and every "run again, or not", in the games of set f1 (tools/replay_analysis/cases.py cards, on the engine branch). The first three lines of a card are what happened; the similar-spots line is a reading, not advice (R-538). Shown on Model > Game review > Flag advice; his marks are in flag_card_marks.json. A card keeps the id it was first written with (`play` is its play now), so his marks stay on it; `changed` says what is told differently from the card he marked, and the page then asks for that card again; `gone` lists the cards he marked that are no longer written.
